concepts.quote: positive is not printed, because x > 0 is false.
concepts.why: The student ignores the ';' after if (x > 0) and reads the next line as the if body, but in Java that empty statement is the whole body, so positive is always printed.
The answer says nothing about assignment.
The student correctly evaluates x > 0 as false for x = -3.
